actions.name: 도시코드 목록 (버스·고속·시외·열차)
actions.description: The 도시코드 every bus, express, suburbs and train action needs. Each service publishes its own list under its own base, so `service` names which one to read; they have not been measured against each other. The scooter service is NOT here — its cityCode is a 지역번호 from scooter-providers.

params.service: Which service's list: bus-route | bus-arrival | bus-location | bus-stop | express | suburbs | train

actions.name: 버스정류소 검색 (이름·번호)
actions.description: Find bus stops in a city by name or by the number posted on the sign. Returns nodeid, which every arrival and position action needs, plus the stop coordinates.

actions.name: 좌표 근처 버스정류소
actions.description: Bus stops near a WGS84 coordinate. The way in when you have a location but no city code — the result carries citycode as well as nodeid.

actions.name: 정류소 경유 노선 목록
actions.description: Which bus routes pass a given stop, with first and last stop names. Answers "what can I catch here".

actions.name: 버스노선 검색 (노선번호)
actions.description: Find routes in a city, optionally by the number on the front of the bus. Returns routeid, plus first and last departure times and the terminus names.

actions.name: 노선 경유 정류소 목록 (순서·좌표)
actions.description: Every stop on a route in running order, with coordinates and an up/down direction code. This is the route drawn as a line — the stop sequence a position or an arrival estimate is measured against.

actions.name: 노선 상세 (배차간격·첫차·막차)
actions.description: One route's details: first and last departure, and the headway for weekdays, Saturdays and Sundays separately.

actions.name: 정류소 실시간 도착정보 (전 노선)
actions.description: Live arrivals at one stop: for each approaching bus, how many stops away it is and the estimated seconds until it arrives. Refreshed every 10-20 seconds. This is the one to ask "when is my bus".

actions.name: 정류소 실시간 도착정보 (특정 노선)
actions.description: The same live arrival estimate narrowed to one route, for when a stop serves many and only one matters.

actions.name: 노선 운행버스 실시간 위치
actions.description: Where every bus on a route is right now: map-matched coordinates, the stop it is at and its sequence number, and the vehicle number. Refreshed every 10-20 seconds — these are the points to put on a map.

actions.name: 노선의 특정 정류소 접근 버스 위치
actions.description: The position of buses on a route as they approach one particular stop.

actions.name: 고속버스 터미널 목록 (도착정보용 코드)
actions.description: Express bus terminals, returning tmnCd — the BARE number (010) used by the arrival actions. Note this is a different identifier from the prefixed terminalId (NAEK010) that express-schedule takes, for the same terminals.

actions.name: 출발터미널 기준 도착지 목록
actions.description: Which terminals you can reach from one departure terminal. Narrows the pair before asking for arrivals.

actions.name: 고속버스 도착예정정보 (현위치·남은시간)
actions.description: Express buses running between two terminals right now: departure time, operator, grade, current location name, minutes remaining and estimated arrival. Refreshed every 20 minutes.

actions.name: 고속버스 터미널 목록 (시간표용 ID)
actions.description: Express bus terminals, returning terminalId — the PREFIXED id (NAEK010) that express-schedule takes. Not interchangeable with tmnCd from express-terminals-arr.

actions.name: 고속버스 등급 목록
actions.description: Express bus grades (일반, 우등 and so on) with their ids.

actions.name: 고속버스 시간표·운임
actions.description: Scheduled express services between two terminals on a date, with departure and arrival times, grade and fare. A timetable, not live running.

actions.name: 시외버스 터미널 목록
actions.description: Intercity (시외) bus terminals by name or city, returning terminalId.

actions.name: 시외버스 등급 목록
actions.description: Intercity bus grades with their ids.

actions.name: 시외버스 시간표·운임
actions.description: Scheduled intercity services between two terminals on a date, with times, grade and fare.

actions.name: 시/도별 기차역 목록
actions.description: Train stations in one province or metropolitan city, returning the station id that train-schedule takes.

actions.name: 열차 종류 목록
actions.description: Train types (KTX, ITX and so on) with their codes.

actions.name: 기차 시간표 (출발역·도착역)
actions.description: Trains between two stations, optionally on a date and of one type. Omitting the date reads today. This is the intercity/KTX rail service, NOT the subway: its station ids come from train-stations and look like NAT010000. A subway station id (MTR...) belongs to subway-timetable and is refused here.

actions.name: 지하철역 검색 (역명)
actions.description: Subway stations by name, returning the station id and which line it is on. A station served by several lines comes back once per line.

actions.name: 지하철역 출구별 버스노선
actions.description: Which bus routes are reachable from each numbered exit of a station.

actions.name: 지하철역 출구별 주변 시설
actions.description: What is near each numbered exit of a station.

actions.name: 지하철역 시간표 (요일·방향별)
actions.description: Departure and arrival times at one station for a day type and a direction, with the terminus of each train. Subways run to schedule, so the next train is this table plus the current time — there is no live subway feed in TAGO and none is needed. Timetable coverage is uneven LINE BY LINE and cannot be predicted from the station id, the operator or the region — measured 2026-08-13 across 32 line families. Answering: 서울 1·2·3·4·5·7·8호선, 신림선, 경의중앙, 수인분당, 경춘, 경강, 동해, 대경선, 서해선, 부산김해경전철. Empty: 서울 6호선 (the one exception inside an otherwise complete operator), the 코레일 stretch of 1호선, 부산·대구·대전·인천·광주 metros, 신분당, 공항철도, GTX-A, 에버라인, 자기부상. Station, exit and exit-facility lookups DO cover the whole country; only the timetable is patchy. An empty schedule is TAGO not returning that line right now — a standing gap or a temporary outage, and the response cannot tell which. It is NOT a wrong id and NOT "no trains": say that it came back empty and when, and do not re-look-up the id. `subway-stations` returns one row per line at a station, so when one line is empty another line at the same station may still answer. If the line asked about is the empty one, STOP querying TAGO: no other action here carries subway timetables — train-schedule is a different service with its own NAT-prefixed station ids and will not answer for a subway station. What remains is a web search or telling the user the source does not have it; either beats more calls returning the same empty list. ⚠️ dailyTypeCode 02 (토요일) returns zero on every line measured — 8 of 8, including lines whose 01 and 03 tables are full. The code itself is live and correct: rows echo dailyTypeCode 01 and 03 back, and no undocumented alternative works (1, 2, 3, 00, 04, 05 and SAT all return nothing). So 02 is a valid slot that was never populated. Whether 03 covers Saturday as well cannot be told from the feed — so do not present 03 as a Saturday timetable. Say the Saturday table is not published and offer 03 for what it is.

params.dailyTypeCode: 01=평일, 02=토요일, 03=일요일. 02 is empty on every line measured; do not silently substitute 03 for it

actions.name: 공항 목록
actions.description: Domestic airports with their ids.

actions.name: 항공사 목록
actions.description: Airlines with their ids.

actions.name: 국내선 항공편 (시간·운임)
actions.description: Domestic flights between two airports on a date: flight number, airline, times, and economy and business fares.

actions.name: 항구 목록 (이름 검색)
actions.description: Ports whose name contains the given text, returning the port id.

actions.name: 여객선터미널 목록
actions.description: Passenger ferry terminals.

actions.name: 선박 종류 목록
actions.description: Vessel types.

actions.name: 선박 운항정보 (출발지 기준)
actions.description: Sailings from a port on a date.

actions.name: 카셰어링 차고지 검색 (이름)
actions.description: Car-sharing zones whose name matches, with address, coordinates and zone type.

actions.name: 카셰어링 차고지 검색 (주소)
actions.description: Car-sharing zones by address text.

actions.name: 좌표 근처 카셰어링 차고지
actions.description: Car-sharing zones within a radius of a coordinate.

actions.name: 공유킥보드 운영사·지역 목록
actions.description: Which scooter operators serve which regions. This is also the ONLY source of the cityCode that `scooters` takes — a 지역번호, not the 도시코드 the bus actions use.

actions.name: 탑승 가능 공유킥보드 (좌표·배터리)
actions.description: Rideable scooters for one operator in one region: device id, battery level and coordinates. Refreshed every 10 seconds.

params.cityCode: 지역번호 from scooter-providers — NOT the city-codes list
